text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aghhh, I couldn't win. But Turbo was so
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I wanna win next time, though. Yeah. I
just need
to work harder.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh! Speak of the devil!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I beat Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay! Go meeee!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haha. She practically flew out of here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wait, isn't the station the other way?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: T-Turbo! Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'm on top of the woooorld! Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Turbo! That's the way to Saitama!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I can't run anymore...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Where am I anyway?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Um... H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Phew! There you are! I lost sight of you
for a
minute and almost freaked out!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
This isn't the way to the academy! It's
the total
opposite!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's a bus stop over there, so let's
take the bus
back.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Thank goodness you came! I was
sooo
scared!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Awww! There, there...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Are you thirsty? I've got some juice.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'm super thirsty! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Twin Turbo falls asleep from

exhaustion, so Matikanetannhauser gives
her a
piggyback ride back home.
